profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Highly motivated and experienced software developer with over 16 years of industry experience. Core strengths include a solid understanding of object-oriented programming, design, distributed programming, software development life cycle, and software development methodologies balanced with strong communication and leadership skills.

• In-depth knowledge of object-oriented principles and design with strong programming skills in Java.
• Experienced in working with Rest API, Spring, databases, distributed programming, and cloud technologies.
• Knowlegeful in Python and C.
• Well understands software development life cycle and configuration management.
• Solid understanding of the use of agile software development methodologies, Scrum, Sprint, Continuous Integration
• Solid management skills, including leading and mentoring individuals
• Cross-functional collaboration. 
• Excellent communication skills.

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Infor acquired Starmount in 2016.
Worked on a micro services based cloud(AWS) application to optimize routing for manufacturing and field support by meeting the required constraints and orchestrating and leveraging unstructured data store(Redis, DynamoDB, Elastic).

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
Engage POS system equips sales associates with relevant product, promotions,
inventory, order, and customer information and provides managers with performance
data analytics, order management, and other back-office tools to optimize front-end
operations. Worked on payment authorization APIs, and multi-channel commerce application workflows employing the latest CI/CD pipelines.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Contributed to various client projects and worked in various roles including client location coordinator and project lead.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin
